Friedrich Nietzsche

Quotes / Friedrich Nietzsche / Q0112

English

One must still have chaos in oneself to be able to give birth to a dancing star.
Thinker Friedrich Nietzsche
School Philosophy of Life
Source Thus Spoke Zarathustra
Theme Creation
Another quotation More from this thinker

Context and commentary are editorial aids for reading. They do not replace the primary text or scholarly commentary.

Source context

This English passage is associated with Thus Spoke Zarathustra, within the tradition of Philosophy of Life. The wording below is a verified rendering prepared for careful reading rather than a claim of unique translation authority.

A short reading

Read in the register of creation, the sentence asks the reader to test an assumption rather than to collect a slogan. In Friedrich Nietzsche's wider work, similar claims are usually offered as prompts for judgment: what would have to be true for the sentence to hold, and what would follow if it did?
